name: Blessing Your Pastor
overview: Scripture calls believers to honor and support their pastors, recognizing them as gifts from God who provide spiritual nourishment and guidance, as promised in Jeremiah 3:15. Blessing and encouraging pastors is a biblical responsibility, exemplified by Paul's gratitude and heartfelt remembrance of his fellow servants in Philippians 1. The Lord's blessing and keeping of His people, articulated in Numbers 6:24, extends to those who shepherd the flock. Furthermore, Galatians 6:6 instructs those taught in the Word to share good things with their teachers, highlighting the mutual care within the body of Christ.
